text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's race day. Past winners offer Kitasan Black advice and encouragement. However, the pressure of having to represent her country is really weighing on her…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, that pressure evaporates as she enters the paddock, where she's greeted by her fans' spirited cheering. She realizes they're carrying the weight along with her as well.
